title: Business Development Executive (Digital Media)
description:
Glasgow / West & Central Scotland - Hybrid Role

Basic to 33 K (rising to 35 K on successful completion of probationary period) + uncapped bonus (OTE 50 K)

Office, home and field based

Our Client
- Is a market leading national media company.
- Have an exceptional reputation for a range of innovative market leading media platforms.
- Instantly recognisable high profile household brand names that cover a range of high impact advertising platforms including publishing, websites, digital media and events.
- Provide business and consumers with quality analysis, insight, news, information and entertainment.
- Their unique network guarantees that their media reaches a targeted and specific audience which is hugely valuable to advertisers.
- They are looking to recruit Business Development Executive

The Role

As a Business Development Consultant you will be
- Working on a leading household brand.
- Selling a unique integrated marketing service to new and existing clients.
- Building effective campaigns across multiple media platforms.
- Solutions including advertising (display, banner), sponsorship, content services, bulletins, podcasts, social, video and events.
- Working on with an existing base of key client accounts and inbound leads
- Self-sourcing new customers.
- Working with clients throughout Glasgow, West and Central Scotland.
- Sectors will include Entertainment, Arts and leisure, Business, Finance, Energy, Health & Beauty, Food & drink, Property and homes, Retail and Travel.
- Liaising and negotiating with senior key decision makers within a range of customer sectors both over the phone, face to face and using video.
- Identify the customer needs and business needs
- Create, design and present innovative media solutions tailored to the client to ensure results.
- With existing clients you will be responsible for building, nurturing and developing account relationships with key decision makers.
- Working with events and content production teams to ensure campaign ideas, delivery and optimum results.
- Maintain an understanding of their market and competitor media.
- Working to targets and deadlines

The Candidate
- An experienced media / advertising sales executive with a solid track record of developing new business and managing existing accounts from any advertising/media sales environment (i.e outdoor, online, radio, newspaper, magazine, directory, etc).
- Consultative in your approach to solution selling.
- You will have a strong understanding of the media and marketing departments.
- Passionate about developing new business opportunities in a competitive market.
- Able to negotiate at all levels.
- Able to understand, present and articulate marketing performance data.
- You will be PC literate, creative, ambitious, articulate, proactive and quick thinking with the ability to develop long term relationships.
- Demonstrate past success and a desire to be the best at what you do.

The Package
- You will be given the rarely available opportunity to work in a team orientated environment for a major household Blue Chip media organisation on a quality media brand.

They are an organisation that values their staff and customers and provides the investment in retaining them.

You will be given full structured training and on-going development opportunities.

Basic salary to 33 K (rising to 35 K on successful completion of probationary period) + uncapped bonus (OTE 50 K) + lots of benefits associated with a leading media company.

APPLY NOW AND MAKE IT HAPPEN!

Choice Consultants are a specialist Media Sales Recruitment Consultancy established in 1999. As a leading Sales Recruitment Consultancy we recruit sales personnel at all levels for a range of international, national and local organisations.

Our clients include top

title: Sales Account Manager (Marketing Solutions)
description:
The Client
- A market leading, cutting edge marketing company and the winner of a number of prestigious business awards.
- They provide their blue chip and SME clients with promotional and retail space in high footfall venues,
- Venues include shopping centres, garden centres, city centres, train stations, retail parks, festivals and airports throughout the UK and abroad.
- These are controlled environments where their brand product or service is placed directly in front of their potential customer audience.
- No.1 in their market their clients include Mercedes, BMW, Lego, Virgin, Sky, Schweppes and BT to name but a few.
- This innovative organisation have experienced continued growth through organic expansion and acquisition due to their unique product offering and increasing product portfolio.

The Role

They currently require a Sales Account Manager.
- To sell their range of marketing/ promotional, retail & media space
- Customers will be a mix of global brands, retailers, experiential marketing agencies, PR firms, local businesses and independent promoters.
- Dealing with a mix of new (50%) and existing customers (50%).
- Role will involve taking inbound calls and making outbound calls to generate business.
- Obtain an understanding of client requirements at both a strategic and a tactical level to be able to offer the best business solutions.
- You will have access to an existing database from which you will contact key decision makers to present their attractive media and retail solutions.
- This will involve working a relaxed, fast paced environment to deadlines and revenue targets.
- You will have the support and back up of strong case studies, metrics and marketing information

The Candidate
- Ideally require a minimum of 6 months successful track record selling any form of media / advertising space (ie. newspaper, magazines, radio, directory, etc).
- Alternatively you will have sales experience from any sector with a genuine interest in marketing.

You will have
- A solid understanding of the sales process.
- An interest in the marketing sector
- Commercial awareness.
- Motivated and enthusiastic with an ethical approach to sales.
- Creative, articulate, proactive and quick thinking with the ability to develop relationships.
- Ability to deal at all levels.
- Desire to pursue a career in the exciting world of marketing and media sales.

The Package

In return you will be given
- The opportunity to join a growing, friendly and innovative successful team.
- Genuine career development and progression opportunities exist.
- Full training

Basic salary to 32 K + uncapped bonus (On Target Bonus 12 K) + benefits

Office based Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday

Home based Wednesday
